# Product integration edges after the current component package

The accepted contact ViewModel has one query/selection. Before wiring a distinct browse hub and
search route, retain an independent unfiltered browse projection/viewport. Do not let a fullscreen
search rewrite the offscreen contacts tab, or clear its query asynchronously during Back and show
a one-frame filtered list. Keep one directory snapshot/subscription while owning the two visible
projections explicitly. Retain search text without treating it as another remote acquisition.

The new SpaceChatRootContent supplies a Group handle around Company composition. Existing public
inbox/thread APIs still accept raw graph/store arguments. Expose the root-bound entry contract to
the application so it cannot accidentally combine one Group graph with another store. Any effect
collector must reject a retired root; consumer-side guards are already present for inbox and
thread effects. Preparation now has both graph and composition ownership, with joined cleanup.

A company filter cannot exclude contacts from the current truncated display labels. The server
query intentionally fetches nine memberships and returns eight plus hasMoreCompanies. No complete
membership contract or company filter has been implemented. Investigate a bounded complete
membership acquisition; do not add per-search network calls, invent missing memberships, or use
private HR profiles for cross-company contact discovery.

Selecting a contact emits peer account ID, not conversation ID. Current preparation can find a
retained canonical conversation or original locally; first-time Open needs admitted discovery.
The entry route must preserve pending/new composer intent separately until canonical identity is
known. Never use peer or command ID as a fake canonical SpaceChatThreadRoute ID.

Keep AppViewModel at its current window owner if introducing a Group NavHost above Company routes.
